crime: For days, the girl had clasped {WITCH_NAME}'s hands in the courtyard, offering gentle reassurance. That day at the upper railing, she confided her fear of execution. {WITCH_NAME} answered through her Magic in the girl's own voice, echoing the reassurance the girl had once given her. The girl asked for a genuine answer instead of an imitation. When the girl said she would never confide in {WITCH_NAME} again, {WITCH_NAME} tipped the girl headfirst over the upper railing during afternoon free time.

As the girl fell, {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic to sound both parts at once: a suicidal farewell in the girl's voice and, over it, a plea in {WITCH_NAME}'s own voice to save the girl. The girl struck her head on the courtyard path and died. A prisoner in the courtyard heard the exchange and believed the girl had jumped while {WITCH_NAME} tried and failed to save her.

In the trial court, a prisoner reviewed a phone video of the fall. The farewell continued through the instant the girl's head struck the path. The prisoners saw what that timing meant: {WITCH_NAME}'s Magic had counterfeited the farewell and paired it with a staged rescue plea, hiding the push beneath an apparent suicide.
fields.epitaph: The girl's request for a genuine answer will echo forever, unanswered.
execution: The execution stand locks her upright inside a cello-shaped frame, leaving her throat exposed. A steel bow begins sawing back and forth across it. Even after her throat falls silent and her body goes still, the bow keeps moving.

magic.name: Voice Unbound
magic.text: She can turn her voice into any sound she can imagine.
